section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Rear Drive Shaft
ocr_text:
RA-18                    REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Rear Drive Shaft

                                                    4.    DISASSEMBLE TRIPOD JOINT
Matchmarks                                              (a)  Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.
                                                        (b)  Using a punch and hammer, place matchmarks on the
                                                             shaft and tripod.

RA4467


                                                        (c)  Using a brass bar and hammer, remove the tripod joint
                                                             from the drive shaft.

RA4468


                                                    5.    REMOVE INBOARD JOINT BOOT

RA4086


                                                    6.    REMOVE OUTBOARD JOINT BOOT CLAMPS AND BOOT
                                                          NOTICE:  Do not disassemble the outboard joint.

RA4066


                                                    7.    REMOVE DUST DEFLECTOR
                                                          Using a screwdriver and hammer, remove the dust
                                                          deflector.

RA4087
